verdict.rationale: The official Svelte GitHub repository points developers to "stop by the Discord chatroom", and svelte.dev invites users to join the Discord server alongside Svelte Society, the sister organisation that runs events. Together these first-party sources confirm an official community chatroom exists. Both mentions are brief, though. Missing for 10: documentation of help/support channels within the chatroom, details on how to join or what it offers, independent or hands-on corroboration of getting help there.
